sections.heading: PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
sections.text: Software engineer with an architecture focus - I design systems rather than only implement features. I currently own the software architecture of a greenfield restaurant POS system (Laravel, PostgreSQL, TypeScript/Alpine.js), applying layered architecture, Domain-Driven Design and event-driven thinking while balancing maintainability, performance and security. I also steward a large, historically grown legacy codebase, where I map undocumented dependencies before changing them. I work from principles - Clean Code, SOLID, design patterns - and back decisions with tests (Codeception, PHPUnit) and static analysis. I am currently deepening cloud architecture, Kubernetes and distributed systems (Kafka).

items.title: AI-Assisted Web Development
bullets: Own the software architecture of a greenfield restaurant POS system: a layered Laravel/PostgreSQL backend and a TypeScript/Alpine.js frontend, designed for clear separation of concerns and long-term maintainability.
Apply Domain-Driven Design and event-driven thinking to model the domain, and translate business requirements from executive management and the Product Owner into a maintainable design.
Define quality gates: test automation with Codeception and PHPUnit (BDD, Gherkin) plus static analysis, so the codebase stays reviewable as it grows.
Maintain CI/CD pipelines in GitLab and the container setup with Docker.
Use AI tools for code analysis, architectural exploration and code generation in daily development workflows.

items.title: Software Development (AI-Assisted)
bullets: Conceived requirements-appropriate software solutions and built custom applications (ticketing systems, web applications) end to end, from requirements engineering to implementation and maintenance.
Designed, planned and optimized database systems, including schema design and performance.
Reviewed and approved programming work, formulated tasks for the team and wrote user stories with clients - early technical-leadership and design responsibility.
Automated tests with PHPUnit and documented code with PHPDoc.
Formally rated "sehr gut" (very good) in the employment reference; described as an indispensable employee with analytical, solution-oriented thinking.

items.title: Development / Coordination
bullets: Took over a historically grown, non-standard legacy codebase inside a proprietary framework and continue to evolve it.
Analyze complex legacy dependencies and identify technical coupling without existing documentation before making changes.
Debug and extend the system while preserving the existing architecture.
Coordinate a ten-person team, align technical and organizational work, and document processes and domain rules in MediaWiki.

items.title: Laravel Pivot Events (Open Source)
bullets: Designed and published an open-source Laravel package that adds pivot (many-to-many) events with custom IDs, working against Laravel's internals.
Focused the package on a clean, predictable API - a small exercise in design from the consumer's point of view.

items.title: Execution Research & Backtesting Platform
bullets: Built a quantitative backtesting environment to evaluate very large parameter spaces (tens to hundreds of millions of combinations) fast enough to iterate on strategies.
Optimized runtime through JIT compilation, vectorization and algorithmic improvements instead of naive brute force, and designed reproducible, modular scoring workflows.
